name: Ragtop
author: sclemance
description: Tablet mode for convertibles: follows the hinge's tablet-mode switch (auto-detected), auto-rotation with a lock, an Omarchy-themed on-screen keyboard with Esc/Tab/modifier/arrow keys that work with SUPER shortcuts, a touch panel for window management, and touch-typable Omarchy menu, pickers and password prompt. Run install.sh after adding; see README.

barWidget.description: Window shortcuts and rotation lock buttons; only visible in tablet mode or while rotation is locked
